imd._note: IMD's latest extended-range outlook, refreshed by the Nykas Daily Refresh when IMD issues a new one (usually Thursdays). categories: above / near / below for an IMD sub-division only when IMD states it; otherwise left out.
imd.title: IMD extended range forecast (weekly press release), 18 November 2026: current weather status and extended range forecast for the next two weeks (18 November to 2 December 2026)
imd.summary: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan was forecast to cross the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coasts near Gopalpur by noon on 20 November, with isolated extremely heavy rain over Coastal Andhra Pradesh on 19 November. For 26 November to 2 December IMD expects normal rainfall over South Peninsular India, with isolated heavy rain over Tamil Nadu and Kerala on some days; Rayalaseema is not named.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.text: No specific rainfall category for South Peninsular India: IMD expects above-normal rainfall over most of East and Northeast India and below normal over the remaining parts of the country. Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan to cross the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to Gopalpur, by noon on 20 November; isolated extremely heavy rain over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam on 19 November and very heavy rain on 20 November.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Not named in the release; the nearest statement is isolated extremely heavy rain over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam on 19 November and very heavy rain on 20 November as the cyclone crosses the north Andhra Pradesh coast.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated heavy rainfall likely over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal during 23–25 November.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.text: Rainfall activity is likely to be normal over South Peninsular India and below normal over the remaining parts of the country; isolated heavy rainfall likely over Tamil Nadu and Kerala on some days.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Not named individually; IMD expects normal rainfall over South Peninsular India as a whole.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated heavy rainfall likely over Tamil Nadu and Kerala on some days; normal rainfall expected over South Peninsular India as a whole.

season.text: IMD's monthly outlook for November 2026: rainfall over South Peninsular India (Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam, Rayalaseema, Kerala & Mahe and South Interior Karnataka taken together) is most likely to be below normal (less than 77% of the long-period average of about 118.7 mm).
